boxes.text: Name the feeling, find the word; say it, get heard.

ONE TINY TRY FOR TODAY
Tonight, name one feeling: hurt, angry, disappointed, or something else.

WHAT SCIENCE SAYS
In research, teens found feelings harder to tell apart than adults. This study did not test teaching the move.

WHAT I CAN DO
When I notice ______, I ______.
Backup: Breathe out slowly

HOW TO REMEMBER IT
Name the feeling, find the word; say it, get heard.
Touch your chest. Say the feeling's name.
